copyMethod: Resumed pre-review certification run 20260805-115001: Python extended-length copier (os.scandir + shutil.copy2, \\?\ paths) with explicit error collection; incremental re-copy of authorized post-edit files; independent full-tree verification; no environment exemptions. The recorded aggregate excludes exactly five generated/self-referential artifacts (backup receipt, candidate manifest, live validation result, challenge report, three-file repair report): the receipt records the tree aggregate, the candidate manifest records the receipt hash, and the live validation result records the manifest aggregate, so no full-tree fixed point exists when regenerated reports carry fresh timestamps. Every per-file comparison and the external full-tree aggregate comparison still cover every file byte-for-byte.
copyCommand: python fallback copier: os.scandir extended-length walk, mkdir every directory, shutil.copy2 every file, explicit error collection, no silent skips; incremental shutil.copy2 for changed authorized files

policy.casePolicy: preserve original case; compare normalized paths using ordinal comparison
policy.symlinkPolicy: do not follow links; symlink entries are excluded from enumeration
policy.junctionPolicy: os.path.islink junction detection; junction entries are excluded from enumeration
policy.aggregateConstruction: sorted path:sha256 records joined by newline
